items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: I had a boy writing for me at that time, who later died of cancer, Nick Cooper. And he was a tremendous writer.

ctx.x: After the first one burned down, the place. So then I started over there with about seven pieces or eight pieces. And then I continued to — Mike, talk to him. So we went up to about 13 pieces. That's the time when Buddy was talking about, that he would come over, and then it was just a 13-piece band and these chorus -- well, there was a lot of excitement, man. And then we had special arrangements. I had a boy writing for me at that time, who later died of cancer, Nick Cooper. And he was a tremendous writer. And…
